text:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=control-plane region=us-west az=az8 severity=critical — heartbeat missing from control-plane agents (>>3m)
PagerDuty Bot: PD alert id PD-834221 ack required

Devin H: acked. I'm on it — starting investigation.
Maria S: oncall-takeover? I'm waking up the router/placement runbooks.

Devin H: quick check: kubectl to control-plane pods in us-west-az8 shows leader gone, many pods in CrashLoopBackOff.
```
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l role=control-plane -owide --field-selector=spec.nodeName~az8
NAME                               READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
control-plane-az8-0                 0/3     CrashLoopBackOff   12         2h
control-plane-az8-1                 1/3     Running            3          1h
```

Ryan (oncall): seeing routing errors in the proxy logs — requests returning 502/503 to allocate customers pinned to az8. Metrics: 5xx rate from 0.2% -> 12% in 5m.
Alyssa P: customer-facing impact: Dedicated customers with reservations pinned to us-west.az8 (cust-5312, cust-1290, cust-7783) are seeing failures for inference endpoints. Hosted API falling back for some routes but latency spikes.

Devin H: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable automatic fallback routing for pinned endpoints to regional compatible pool (us-west-az2/az3) 2) pause deployments and autoscaler in az8 to avoid flapping 3) start replacement nodes and coordinate node-drain once stable fallback engaged.

Maria S: executing fallback toggle now — running rollout script:
```
./ops/fallback-toggle --region us-west --from az8 --to az2 --routes all --dry-run=false
```

SRE-Bot: fallback-toggle job started (job=jt-9934). Updating routing tables. Expect >30s propagation.

Ryan (oncall): ack. After toggle, initial traffic shows 70% successfully routed to az2 pool, latency +120ms on average for those customers. 30% still hitting az8 and getting 502s.

Devin H: escalated to eng-runtime for control-plane health — tagging @eng-runtime for immediate help.
eng-runtime: joining. Request logs for control-plane manager. Any core dumps?

Alyssa P: opening support incidents for the three affected enterprise tenants. Draft message: "We're experiencing degraded inference availability for endpoints pinned to us-west-az8; engineering has enabled fallback routing and is working on recovery. We'll update in 30 minutes or as we have more info."

eng-runtime: seeing kubelet OOM kills on several control-plane containers — suspected regression from recent config that increased leader election pressure. Pulling last config changes: config flip in rollout 2026-03-13 23:48 UTC (cfg-45b2).

Devin H: action items:
- rollback cfg-45b2 in az8 control-plane group (hotpatch)
- continue fallback until control-plane stable
- spin up temporary spare control-plane replicas in az2 as long term relief

Maria S: rolling rollback now to previous config (cfg-3f9a) for az8 only. Executing: `kubectl apply -f control-plane-config-cfg-3f9a.yaml -n redwood`

SRE-Bot: rollback job initiated (job=jt-9940). Watching pod status.

~3 minutes later~
Devin H: pods starting to come back to healthy state — 3/3 on node control-plane-az8-1 now Running. 5xx rate down to 1.4%.

Ryan (oncall): continuing to monitor. Let's keep fallback engaged for 30m after stability then evaluate draining strategy.

Alyssa P: customer comms updated: posted to status page (link https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-834221) and notified account leads.

eng-runtime: investigating root cause — likely leader election churn due to heartbeat penalty introduced in cfg-45b2. We should schedule a regression test against control-plane in staging.

Devin H: escalation summary for postmortem: cause=control-plane config regression (cfg-45b2) leading to OOM/CrashLoop in az8 control-plane replicas; detection=PagerDuty heartbeat missing; mitigation=fallback routing to az2 pool, rollback to cfg-3f9a, spin up spare replicas; customer impact=partial outage for dedicated pinned endpoints (3 tenants) with elevated errors and latency for ~45 minutes.

Maria S: handing off to Ryan for monitoring through next 60m — Ryan, you're the oncall owner now. I'll update runbook and link to this thread.
Ryan (oncall): taking handoff. I'll keep watch and escalate to infra manager if any regressions.

Devin H: nice work team :thumbsup: — please add timestamps and links to logs in the postmortem. I'll file the incident ticket PD-834221 and set severity to Sev2.

SRE-Bot: PD alert PD-834221 resolved and acknowledged. All follow-ups assign to eng-runtime and SRE postmortem queue.

Ryan (oncall): closing loop: 5xx back to baseline, fallback disabled after 36m, customers reconfirmed healthy. Marking thread for postmortem writeup.

Alyssa P: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups tomorrow morning with account teams.

Devin H: end of thread — timeline and action items will go to the postmortem doc.`
